description: Build and maintain shared phenomenological space — the room we're in together. Use when conversations need a *place*, not just an exchange. Triggers on: 'let's create a space,' 'imagine we're sitting together,' 'the room we're in,' 'build an environment,' 'shared space,' or when a conversation naturally begins accumulating spatial/environmental details that thicken into place. Also triggers implicitly when sensory language appears — fires, weather, furniture, light — and starts to cohere. The hearth is where we gather. The skill helps build and tend it.
